crossRefs.note: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’
to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.
For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light…
The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: Yahweh gives sight to the eyes of both.
Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.
For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk…
that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and…

translations.web: Truly the light is sweet, and it is a pleasant thing for the eyes to see the sun.
translations.bsb: Light is sweet, and it pleases the eyes to see the sun.
translations.kjv: Truly the light is sweet, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun:
translations.asv: Truly the light is sweet, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun.
